artifacts.name: MedPsy-1.7B
artifacts.capability: Compact medical reasoning for private edge deployment.
artifacts.description: A Qwen3-1.7B medical model post-trained with supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning for text-only healthcare reasoning.
artifacts.contribution: Contributor to the research, evaluation, technical report, and public release.
results: 62.62 closed-ended medical benchmark average
70.33 HealthBench · 54.33 HealthBench Hard

artifacts.name: MedPsy-1.7B GGUF
artifacts.capability: Phone-ready medical inference through llama.cpp and QVAC SDK.
artifacts.description: Deployment-oriented MedPsy weights with seven quantization options for laptops, smartphones, and other memory-constrained devices.
artifacts.contribution: Contributor to the research, evaluation, quantization analysis, and release.
results: Q4_K_M retains 62.16 closed-ended average at 69% smaller than BF16
Q8_0 matches the BF16 benchmark average at 2.16 GB

artifacts.name: MedPsy-4B
artifacts.capability: Higher-capacity medical reasoning at edge scale.
artifacts.description: A Qwen3-4B medical model with multi-stage post-training for clinical knowledge, expert reasoning, and realistic health scenarios.
artifacts.contribution: Contributor to the research, evaluation, technical report, and public release.
results: 70.54 closed-ended medical benchmark average
74.00 HealthBench · 58.00 HealthBench Hard

artifacts.name: MedPsy-4B GGUF
artifacts.capability: Quantized medical reasoning for laptops and high-end mobile devices.
artifacts.description: Deployment weights spanning near-lossless Q8 through compact IQ3 formats, with measured benchmark retention for each option.
artifacts.contribution: Contributor to the research, evaluation, quantization analysis, and release.
results: Q4_K_M retains 69.92 closed-ended average at 69% smaller than BF16
IQ3_M reaches 2.13 GB with a 2.07% relative average-score reduction

artifacts.name: Genesis I Pretrained Model
artifacts.capability: A research checkpoint trained from scratch on Genesis I.

artifacts.contribution: Distributed training infrastructure, pretraining ablations, evaluation, and release analysis within the wider team effort.
results: Trained from scratch on the Genesis I corpus
Released as a research checkpoint, not an instruction-tuned flagship model

artifacts.name: Genesis II Combined Checkpoint

artifacts.name: Genesis II Option-Level Checkpoint

artifacts.name: Genesis II Failure-Analysis Checkpoint

artifacts.name: QVAC Genesis II
artifacts.capability: Failure analysis and option-level reasoning across an expanded curriculum.

artifacts.name: BitNet b1.58 Edge Artifacts
